sentences.text:

Court No. - 79
Case :- Criminal Appeal No. - 347 of 2022
Appellant :- Dr. Dhruv Sharma
Respondent :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Appellant :- Satyendra Kumar Mishra,Praveen Mishra Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.,Pankaj Kumar Singh Hon'ble Subhash Chandra Sharma,J.
Heard Sri Asit Ahmed holding brief of Sri Pawan Kumar Rai learned counsel for the appellant and Sri Ashish Kumar Mishra learned counsel for the respondent.

This criminal appeal under Section 14-A (2) Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act has been preferred by the appellant with the prayer to set aside the bail rejection order dated 22.10.2021 passed by the Special Judge (SC/ST Act), Allahabad.

entities.text: Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
It is submitted that the appellant was on interim bail granted by this Court on 17.05.2023 and condition was imposed that he will get his marriage registered with the Registrar and produce Dr. Dhruv Sharma vs State Of U.P. And Another on 16 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/18955229/
1 registration certificate before this Court which has been filed through supplementary affidavit and is on record which shows that marriage has been registered before the Marriage Registration Officer on 30.09.2023.

entities.text: Dr. Dhruv Sharma vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is also submitted that there is no any complaint of misuse of liberty granted by this Court to the appellant, therefore request to enlarge him on regular bail.
The appellant is languishing in jail since 13.02.2021.
Learned counsel for the appellant also referred to the amended provisions of SC/ST Act.
All these facts were not taken into consideration by the learned Special Judge while rejecting the bail which cannot be said to be lawful, therefore request to set it aside and allow the appeal.
Learned counsel for the respondent as well as learned A.G.A. has no objection in this regard.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case submissions made by learned counsel for the appellant as well as learned A.G.A., perusal of record, in view of marriage entered into between the parties as registered by the Marriage Registration Officer, there appears ground for bail in favour of the appellant and the order passed by learned trial court cannot be said to be lawful and is liable to be set-aside and the appeal is to be allowed.
Accordingly, the appeal is allowed and the impugned order rejecting the bail application of the appellant is set-aside.
Let the appellant Dr. Dhruv Sharma involved in Case Crime No. 202 of 2019 under Sections 376,
328, 504 and 506 I.P.C. and 3(2)(V) SC/ST Act, Police Station Kaundhiyara, District Prayagraj be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond and two heavy sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions.
Further, before issuing the release order, the sureties be verified.
1. The appellant will not tamper with the evidence during the trial.
2. The appellant will not pressurize/ intimidate the prosecution witness.
3. The appellant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
4. The appellant shall not commit an offence similar to the offence of which he is accused, or suspected, of the commission of which he is suspected.

5. The appellant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move bail cancellation application before this Court.

Order Date :- 16.2.2024 Suraj Srivastav  Dr. Dhruv Sharma vs State Of U.P. And Another on 16 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/18955229/
